title: Theme sale - Discussion
author: Just_Paterek
selftext:
Hello guys.

My game was accepted on both Theme sales, Cyberpunk and Pins a Pegs, and I got serious question regarding that.

I seen a lot of posts of game being boosted by those theme sales. Did you attend any theme sale before? Did you do anything special?

I got marketing prepared starting 1.8. but I was thinking if I could do something more during that time period.

This is my first game ever but for sure not last. But I would like to give it my maximun so for that reason I am looking for advices or any open discussion that could help me promote my game more during those sales, and also it could help others.

Thank you.
